name: Solstice Pendulum Atoll
core_rationale: Twelfth floating basalt-and-starlight pendulum island of Continent 03 where Vesper's longest inverted gravity chain swings between the summer and winter solstice beacons.
local_conflict: Solstice chime-wraiths and pendulum-weight constructs patrol the swinging starlight anchor-piers.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Astrolabe keepers in Celestial Astrolabe Sanctuary say Solstice Pendulum Atoll swings across a two-kilometer arc of open sky once every twelve hours.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A floating basalt atoll suspended from a colossal starlight pendulum chain beyond the eastern rim of Celestial Astrolabe Atoll.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What counter-gravity anchor prevents Solstice Pendulum Atoll from colliding with the outer halo ring?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-vesper-dream-eater and scar-vesper-crater along the outer solstice arc of Continent 03.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: A floating basalt atoll swinging on a colossal starlight pendulum chain between twin solstice beacons.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: pendulum-pier walkway and solstice beacon metrics for 1.05m characters will be verified upon promotion to Draft.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: reserved as the twelfth District frontier on Continent 03 with zero filler maps.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Provides complete mystery_hook (in_world_rumor, visual_silhouette, unanswered_question) and empty grid_nodes.
